title: Does maniac's patch work on the official version of 2000 sold on Humble Bundle?

posts.author: taiguerrobocopi
posts.body: I keep hearing that the patch works only on "the official version sold on steam", but I dunno if the "sold on steam" part is a clarfification of where one could buy it or denoting that they have to buy it there.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Any software sold on Humble Bundle
is
on Steam.

posts.author: taiguerrobocopi
posts.body:
Thanks.
Still turns out the patch won't work on 2000 games at all, only 2003.
Is there a similar patch for rpg maker 2000?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just out of curiosity, if you don't already own one of the RPG Maker engines, why choose such an old one in the hopes that this third party patch will make it do extra things?
Why not just get one of the newer engines that take JavaScript plugins to change literally anything you want? Or even the VX series that can use Ruby scripts?
They all go on sale very inexpensively throughout the year, I'd expect next month on Black Friday you could take your pick.
Or are you asking this because you
do
own 2000 and you're trying to mod it?
